about_the_game:
[Figure Shop Simulator: Prologue is a free version prepared for you to experience the Figure Shop Simulator in advance. This version contains limited content and allows you to try out the general mechanics of the game.]

Figure Shop Simulator is a fun and detailed business simulation game where you manage your own figure store. Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer your customers the best shopping experience.

To grow your business, manage your warehouse efficiently, expand your store, and personalize its design. Create rare figures for collectors, follow trends, and increase your profit by stocking the most in-demand figures.

But be careful! Inventory management, customer satisfaction, and pricing are critical to your success. Can you make the right strategic decisions to bring your store to the top of the industry?

Main Features:

  • 3D figure production and customization

  • Shelf management, pricing, and customer satisfaction

  • Create collection sets and discover rare figures

  • Follow market trends and identify best-selling products

  • Build your store from scratch and become the biggest name in the figure collection world!

  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
